meaning:
trembling
Another spelling of re.a.dah (רְעַדָה "trembling" H7461B)

elsewhere.note: Then the chiefs of Edom were dismayed. Trembling takes hold of the mighty men of Moab. All the inhabitants of Canaan have melted away.
fear came on me, and trembling, which made all my bones shake.
Serve Yahweh with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
The sinners in Zion are afraid. Trembling has seized the godless ones. Who among us can live with the devouring fire? Who among us can live with everlasting…
